name: Mia Ragazza
about: Mia Ragazza is a lively, two-story Italian restaurant and cocktail bar on Main Street in Manayunk, known for putting a Philly spin on Central Italian cooking. Opened in September 2023 by the team behind Goat's Beard, it pairs a dressy-casual neighborhood feel with separate indoor and outdoor spaces.

name: Landmark Americana Tap & Grill
about: Landmark Americana's City Line location is a tap and grill on North 54th Street in Wynnefield, a sister to the group's University City bar. It's set up for watching big games and events on its many TVs, takes reservations for large events, and serves a late-night menu after the full kitchen closes.

name: Timeout Sports Bar
about: TimeOut Sports Bar is a local sports bar at 22nd Street and Hunting Park Avenue in Hunting Park, where fans cheer on the hometown teams on high-definition TVs. It has a relaxed, casual-attire feel, with a weekly lineup of karaoke, old-school music nights and DJ parties.

name: Oasis Club
about: Oasis Club is a 21-and-over gentlemen's club on Essington Avenue in Eastwick, a few minutes from Philadelphia International Airport and Center City. It hosts themed nights, events tied to Flyers and 76ers games, and private parties such as bachelor parties and birthdays, and it has secure on-site parking.

name: Tiffany on the Blvd
about: Tiffany on the Blvd is a Northeast Philadelphia restaurant and bar on Roosevelt Boulevard in Bustleton, serving scratch-made comfort classics in hearty portions. It opened in 1984, and since 2002 it has been run by three brothers who started out as line cooks there; it also makes cakes and desserts and hosts parties.

name: Chickie's & Pete's Cafe
about: Chickie's & Pete's on Packer Avenue is a large South Philadelphia sports bar steps from the Sports Complex, known for its Crabfries and seafood. At 24,000 square feet it is the biggest of the chain's Philadelphia locations, with three bars and a 14-foot TV, and the brand started as a single corner taproom in Mayfair.

name: Le Virtù
about: Le Virtù is an Abruzzese Italian restaurant on East Passyunk Avenue in South Philly, opened in 2007 by Francis Cratil-Cretarola and Cathy Lee as a tribute to their family's home region of Abruzzo. It also draws on Southern Italian cooking, hosts special events such as its marathon Panarda feast, and has an outdoor garden called Il Campo.

name: Hilltown Tavern
about: Hilltown Tavern is a modern Irish American gastropub on Roxborough Avenue serving the Roxborough and Manayunk community. It has indoor, outdoor and tent seating with TVs for sports, outdoor space that welcomes families and pets, off-street parking, weekend brunch and Thursday trivia.

name: Sor Ynez
about: Sor Ynez is a regional Mexican restaurant in Kensington from Jill Weber, who also owns Jet Wine Bar, with a menu known for vegetable-forward takes on traditional dishes and cocktails focused on mezcal and tequila. It is named for the 17th-century Mexican poet and scholar Sor Juana Ynez de la Cruz.

name: Jaffa Bar
about: Jaffa Bar is a two-story oyster and cocktail bar in a 19th-century former firehouse on North Howard Street in Olde Kensington, from CookNSolo's Mike Solomonov and Steve Cook. It opened in October 2024 as the group's first restaurant to serve shellfish, with an oyster bar downstairs and a bar and dining room upstairs.

name: Pub & Kitchen
about: Pub & Kitchen is a neighborhood tavern and restaurant at the corner of 20th and Lombard streets in Graduate Hospital, pairing European-influenced cooking with the warmth of a classic pub. It opened in September 2008 and serves a seasonal menu alongside a full bar.

name: Bar Hygge
about: Bar Hygge is a brewpub on Fairmount Avenue, opened in 2016 by Tom Baker and Peggy Zwerver of Earth Bread + Brewery with Julie and Stew Keener of Bagataway Tavern; its name is a Danish word for conviviality. Reclaimed windows look into its ten-barrel brewhouse, and the bar is built from a 120-year-old sweetgum tree.

name: White Dog Cafe
about: White Dog Cafe is a farm-to-table American restaurant on Sansom Street in University City, set in three connected Victorian brownstones steps from the University of Pennsylvania. Founded by Judy Wicks in January 1983, it serves seasonal menus in distinct rooms including the Oak Room, Solarium, Wine Cellar and Porch.

name: Landmark Americana Tap And Grill
about: Landmark Americana Tap & Grill is a sports bar and grill at 33rd and Market streets on Drexel University's campus in University City, opened in March 2010. It has plenty of TVs for watching big events, plus outdoor seating and a late-night menu.

name: Village Whiskey
about: Village Whiskey is a whiskey bar from Chef Jose Garces at the corner of 20th and Sansom streets in Rittenhouse, with more than 200 whiskeys. Garces envisioned it as a place where he and his team could have a drink after a long night in the kitchen, and it pairs whiskey and cocktails with an all-American menu built around its burger.

name: Ruth's Chris Steak House
about: Ruth's Chris Steak House at 18th and Market streets is the steakhouse chain's Center City location, in the Sonesta Hotel building. It moved here from Broad Street in 2016 with a brighter look than a traditional steakhouse: secluded booths, mirrors, a wine display holding 2,000 bottles, and a mural about Philadelphia.

name: Puttshack Philadelphia Liberty
about: Puttshack is a high-tech indoor mini golf venue and bar at the Shops at Liberty Place, at 16th and Chestnut streets in Center City, from a company that started in London in 2018. It opened in February 2024 with microchipped balls that track scores, plus a large bar with TVs.

name: Thanal Indian Tavern
about: Thanal Indian Tavern is a two-level corner restaurant and bar at 20th and Arch streets in Logan Square, focused on South Indian and especially Tamil cooking; co-owner Hariharan Karmegam is from Madurai. It serves thalis and regional dishes alongside a full bar of spice-infused, Indian-themed cocktails.

name: Dear Daphni
about: Dear Daphni is a Mediterranean restaurant from Michael Schulson's Schulson Collective in the Laurel condo tower near Rittenhouse Square, centered on kebabs from an open charcoal grill served with mezze and craft cocktails. It opened in December 2024 with 155 seats, including a 12-seat bar, plus outdoor dining in season.

name: Cavanaugh's Rittenhouse
about: Cavanaugh's Rittenhouse is a sports bar on Sansom Street in Rittenhouse that shows Eagles, Flyers and 76ers games along with college football, soccer and basketball. It opened at this location in fall 2022, just in time for the NFL season, and serves bar favorites like wings, burgers and mac and cheese.

name: Aleksandar
about: Restaurant Aleksandar is an upscale restaurant and bar in a double brownstone on 19th Street just off Rittenhouse Square. It opened in August 2022 under Aleksandar Stojnic, who grew up in Bremen, Germany, and the space seats about 100, with a lounge area by the bar.

name: Cavanaugh's Headhouse
about: Cavanaugh's Headhouse is a sports bar and pub on Headhouse Square in Queen Village, with an army of flatscreens showing everything from the NFL to Champions League soccer. Its seven themed rooms include a dart room and the Irish pub-style Picwik Room, and it is known for wings tossed in its Irish whisky Cav's sauce.

name: Bloomsday Wine Pub and Retail Shop
about: Bloomsday is an all-day cafe, natural wine bar and bottle shop on South 2nd Street, across from the Headhouse Square Shambles in Society Hill. Opened in May 2019 by Green Engine Coffee owners Kelsey Bush and Zach Morris, its roughly 2,800-square-foot space features a working fireplace, a marble-topped bar and a living moss wall.

name: Triangle Tavern
about: Triangle Tavern is a corner bar at 10th and Reed Streets serving South Philly-style Italian fare with rotating draft and bottled beers, wine by the carafe, adult water ice and cocktails. The tavern has occupied the corner since the end of Prohibition and was reopened in May 2015 by Stephen Simons and David Frank, owners of Royal Tavern and Khyber Pass Pub.

name: Spasso Italian Grill
about: Spasso Italian Grill is a casual Italian restaurant on Front Street in Old City, where an open kitchen turns out fresh seafood, meat and homemade pasta and every dessert is made on the premises. Along with its dining room and seasonal outdoor seating, it has a full bar, a lounge and banquet rooms for groups of 20 to 200.

name: Jerry's Bar
about: Jerry's Bar is a neighborhood gastropub on Laurel Street in Northern Liberties, serving craft beer, specialty cocktails, wine and a menu that runs from pierogies to weekend brunch. Once an old-school shot-and-a-beer corner tavern, it was rebuilt by neighbor Bill Proud into a bi-level bar with a white marble bar and a patio on an adjacent lot.

name: Urban Village Brewing Company
about: Urban Village Brewing Company is a brewpub at the Schmidt's Commons, formerly the Piazza, in Northern Liberties, pairing house-brewed seasonal beers with brick-oven pizzas and small plates. Opened in June 2017, the roughly 5,500-square-foot space seats about 155 indoors and out, with fire pits, a large central bar and an open kitchen beside the brewing operation.

name: Terra Grill
about: Terra Grill is a wood-fired steakhouse on Germantown Avenue in Northern Liberties from Michelin-starred French chef Laurent Tourondel, next door to his casual Scusi Pizza. Opened in March 2026, it mixes steakhouse, Italian, Mediterranean and Asian-influenced dishes in a dark-wood dining room with banquettes and a top-lit cocktail bar.

name: Barbuzzo
about: Barbuzzo is a small Mediterranean kitchen and bar on 13th Street in Midtown Village, known for its creative pizzas, small plates and salted caramel budino. Opened in 2010 by Marcie Turney and Valerie Safran, it is credited with helping turn 13th Street into a dining destination, and it adds outdoor seating in warm months.

name: McCormick & Schmick's
about: McCormick & Schmick's is a seafood and steak restaurant at One South Broad Street, across from City Hall on the Avenue of the Arts in Center City. This location of the national chain offers white-tablecloth dining in dark wood-paneled rooms with handcrafted stained glass ceilings and mosaic-tiled floors, plus a bar and lounge.

name: Lion Sports Bar
about: Lion Sports Bar is a Chinatown sports bar on Arch Street between 10th and 11th Streets, built around Philly sports and international soccer on multiple TVs. Opened in March 2025 by four partners including Mark Prinzinger and Jack Chen in a former Chinese restaurant space, it blends Chinese American dishes like General Tso's Nachos with burgers and wings.

name: Bar-Ly
about: Bar-Ly is a sports bar at 11th and Arch Streets in Chinatown, right where Chinatown, the Convention Center and Reading Terminal meet. It pours a rotating list of 60 draft beers in front of dozens of high-definition TVs and serves Asian American pub fare such as pho, bun and rice platters alongside classic bar food.

name: Mamajuana Cafe Philly
about: Mamajuana Cafe Philly is a Latin fusion restaurant and bar on Frankford Avenue in Fishtown, serving dishes from mofongo and churrasco to Latin-inspired sushi rolls with island-style cocktails. Opened in April 2024 as the chain's first Pennsylvania location, it is its largest yet at about 10,000 square feet and roughly 400 seats, including a 30-seat two-sided bar.

name: Cormorant Corner Bar
about: Cormorant Corner Bar is a neighborhood bar at Frankford Avenue and Dauphin Street serving crafted cocktails, twists on classics, cold beer and shots. It comes from The Vintage Syndicate, the group behind Garage and Vintage, and took over the former Bob's Happy Hour Tavern space with frosted beer mugs, a few TVs and a dartboard room.

name: Chris' Jazz Cafe
about: Chris' Jazz Cafe is a jazz club and restaurant on Sansom Street in Center City, presenting local, national and international talent. Founded in 1989, it calls itself the longest continuously operating jazz club in Philadelphia's history and has hosted performers including the Count Basie Orchestra, Pat Martino and Joey DeFrancesco.

name: Giuseppe & Sons
about: Giuseppe & Sons is a modern Italian restaurant in Center City from restaurateur Michael Schulson and the Termini Bros. pastry family, serving handmade pastas, Italian-American classics and craft cocktails. Opened in November 2018 next door to Schulson's Harp & Crown, its dining room sits below street level, with a white Carrara marble bar and black-and-white tile.

name: Good Dog Bar
about: Good Dog Bar is a three-story pub on 15th Street in Center City, with a third-floor game room above two floors of food and drink. It has operated since 2003 in a 100-year-old building that has been a local watering hole since Prohibition, a block from the Broad Street Line.

name: Fado Irish Pub
about: Fadó Irish Pub is the Philadelphia location of the Irish pub chain, on Locust Street in Center City, serving Irish dishes along with snacks, sandwiches and entrees. It shows sports of all kinds with soccer taking priority, airing English Premier League matches live from August through May.

name: Wm. Mulherin's Sons
about: Wm. Mulherin's Sons is an Italian-influenced restaurant and boutique hotel on Front Street in Fishtown, set in a restored former whiskey bottling facility under the El. Named one of Bon Appetit's 50 best new restaurants in 2016, it serves wood-fired fare across two dining rooms and a bar, with four hotel rooms above.

name: Yuhiro Sushi
about: Yuhiro Sushi is an omakase and hand roll sushi bar on East Susquehanna Avenue in Fishtown, opened in fall 2023 by Sam Lin, who also runs Sakana. It pairs a 12-seat bar serving a nigiri omakase with a 12-seat a la carte hand roll bar, backed by a sake, shochu, wine and beer list.

name: Laser Wolf
about: Laser Wolf is an Israeli skewer house from Zahav chefs Michael Solomonov and Steve Cook, set in a former warehouse at Howard and Thompson Streets in Kensington. Opened in February 2020, it serves charcoal-grilled skewers with salatim, hot pita and hummus in a colorful room inspired by Jerusalem's Machane Yehuda Market, with a 12-seat bar by the grill.
